concede defeat: After trailing by thirty points in the final quarter, the coach finally had to concede defeat and congratulate the other team.
最後一節落後三十分，教練最後只好認輸，並恭喜對手。
concede a point: Although she disagreed with most of his ideas, she had to concede a point when he showed her the real numbers.
雖然她不同意他大部分的想法，但當他拿出真實數據時，她不得不承認對方有理。
concede a goal: Our goalkeeper made a terrible mistake in the last minute, and we conceded a goal that cost us the championship.
我們的守門員在最後一分鐘犯下嚴重失誤，我們失了一球，因此丟掉了冠軍。
concede territory: After losing the war, the small country was forced to concede territory to its powerful neighbor.
戰敗之後，那個小國被迫割讓領土給強大的鄰國。
conceive a plan: Lying awake at night, she slowly conceived a plan to save the old bookstore from closing down.
夜裡躺著睡不著時，她慢慢構思出一個計畫，要拯救那家老書店免於歇業。
can't conceive of: Many young people today can't conceive of a world without smartphones and the Internet.
許多現今的年輕人無法想像沒有智慧型手機和網路的世界。
conceive a child: After trying for several years, the couple finally conceived a child and were overjoyed at the news.
嘗試了好幾年後，這對夫妻終於懷孕了，得知消息時欣喜若狂。
be conceived as: The online course was first conceived as a small experiment in the teacher's mind, but it soon became a huge success.
這門線上課程最初被設想為老師腦中的一個小實驗，但很快就大獲成功。
concentrate on studies: With the exam only a month away, she turned off her phone to concentrate on her studies.
距離考試只剩一個月，她關掉手機以專注課業。
concentrate power: The new law allowed the president to concentrate power in his own hands, which worried many citizens.
新法讓總統得以把權力集中在自己手中，令許多公民憂心。
wealth is concentrated: In many countries, most of the wealth is concentrated in the hands of a small number of rich families.
在許多國家，大部分的財富集中在少數富裕家族手中。
concentrate efforts: The company decided to concentrate its efforts on young customers instead of trying to please everyone.
公司決定把力量集中在年輕顧客身上，而不是試圖討好所有人。
condemn violence: In a strong statement, the mayor condemned the violence at the protest and asked everyone to stay calm.
市長在一份措辭強硬的聲明中譴責抗議活動中的暴力，並要求大家保持冷靜。
be condemned to death: The murderer was found guilty by the court and condemned to death, though his lawyer planned to appeal.
那名殺人犯被法院判定有罪並被判死刑，不過他的律師打算上訴。
condemn the building: After the earthquake, officials condemned the building as unsafe to live in, so all the families had to move out.
地震過後，官員宣告這棟建築為危樓、不宜居住，所以所有住戶都得搬出去。
condemn someone to poverty: Losing his job at fifty condemned him to poverty, and he could no longer afford even basic medical care.
五十歲失業使他陷入貧窮，連基本的醫療都負擔不起。
conduct research: Scientists at the university are conducting research on how plastic waste affects sea turtles.
該大學的科學家正在進行研究，探討塑膠垃圾如何影響海龜。
conduct a survey: Our class conducted a survey to find out how many hours students spend on their phones each day.
我們班做了一項調查，想知道學生每天花多少小時在手機上。
conduct an orchestra: At only twenty-five, she was invited to conduct an orchestra, guiding sixty musicians with her small baton.
年僅二十五歲，她就受邀指揮樂團，用小小的指揮棒帶領六十位樂手。
conduct oneself well: The students were reminded to conduct themselves well during the school trip to the national museum.
學生們被提醒在參觀國立博物館的校外教學中要舉止得宜。
conduct electricity: Copper conducts electricity very well, which is why it is used inside most of the wires in our homes.
銅的導電性很好，這就是為什麼我們家中大部分的電線裡都用銅。
conduct business: During the pandemic, many small shops learned to conduct business online through social media and delivery apps.
疫情期間，許多小店學會透過社群媒體和外送應用程式在網路上經商。
confess a crime: After hours of questioning by the police, the young man finally confessed the crime and said he was sorry.
經過警方數小時的偵訊，那名年輕男子終於認罪，並表示很抱歉。
confess one's love: He wrote a long letter to confess his love for her, but he was too shy to send it.
他寫了一封長信要向她告白，但他太害羞了，不敢寄出去。
confess to cheating: When the teacher showed him the identical answers, Kevin confessed to cheating on the math test.
當老師把一模一樣的答案拿給他看時，Kevin承認在數學考試中作弊。
I must confess: I must confess that I didn't read the whole book before writing my report, so it isn't very good.
我得承認，我在寫報告前沒有讀完整本書，所以報告寫得不太好。
confine the discussion to: Since we only have ten minutes, let's confine the discussion to the most important problem on the list.
因為我們只有十分鐘，讓我們把討論限於清單上最重要的問題。
be confined to bed: After breaking his leg in a skiing accident, Tom was confined to bed for two weeks and missed many classes.
滑雪意外摔斷腿後，Tom臥病在床兩週，錯過了很多課。
confine the fire: Firefighters worked all night to confine the fire to one building so it would not spread to nearby homes.
消防員徹夜工作，把火勢控制在一棟建築內，以免蔓延到附近的住家。
confined spaces: People who are afraid of confined spaces often feel nervous in small elevators or crowded subway cars.
害怕密閉空間的人在狹小的電梯或擁擠的地鐵車廂裡常常會感到緊張。
